narrative.overview:
Sournova's visual system is a controlled explosion. Every surface is treated like a wall in Tepito after a concert — saturated, layered, unapologetically loud. But unlike actual chaos, the sticker bomb is intentional: each element knows exactly where it belongs and why. The darkness is always the foundation; the color is always the event.

The system runs dark. Not because tools look cool dark, but because this is the México del OXXO a las 2am — neon on asfalto, someone blasting something from their phone, the smell of tamarindo in the air. Every screen is that moment. The background is deep and absolute; the accents arrive like photon blasts.

Typography is unapologetically large and condensed (Bebas Neue) or confident and direct (Plus Jakarta Sans). There are exactly two font families and zero exceptions. Scale does the heavy lifting: the contrast between a 10rem headline and a 14px label IS the hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Dark base, neon signal — the surface is always night; the color is always electricity
Maximum typographic contrast — Bebas Neue at maximum scale, Plus Jakarta Sans at confident minimum
Flat depth — layers differentiated by surface darkness, never by shadow
Sticker-bomb density — every section carries maximum intent, no neutral breathing rooms
Three-color battery — Limón Eléctrico leads; Verde Tóxico and Rosa Bala support and rotate by context

rules.name: La Regla de la Batería
rules.body: Limón Eléctrico always leads. Verde Tóxico and Rosa Bala can swap position but never both dominate the same viewport simultaneously. One signal at a time.

rules.name: La Regla del Fondo
rules.body: The base is always Noche Profunda or Superficie Oscura. There are no light-mode pages. The only light surface allowed is the newsletter promo strip, and even then the text is Noche Profunda.

rules.name: La Regla de Las Dos Fuentes
rules.body: Exactly two font families: Bebas Neue and Plus Jakarta Sans. No third family, no system fonts in visible UI, no Inter.

rules.name: La Regla del Tamaño
rules.body: If a Bebas Neue heading isn't making someone slightly uncomfortable with how large it is, make it bigger. The display scale is clamp(4rem, 13vw, 10rem) and it does not apologize.

rules.name: La Regla del Asfalto
rules.body: Elevation is expressed in surface darkness. Deeper surfaces are darker. A raised card uses #111111 over a #0a0a0a page. If you reach for a box-shadow, stop and reach for a darker background instead.

rules.name: La Regla del Blob
rules.body: Decorative glow blobs (large blur-3xl radial gradient divs) are atmospheric, not structural. They never carry semantic meaning. They sit below content at pointer-events: none, 10–20% opacity.

dos: Do use Noche Profunda (#0a0a0a) as the base for every primary page section.
Do size Bebas Neue display text at clamp(4rem, 13vw, 10rem) or larger for hero headlines.
Do use Limón Eléctrico as the CTA color on every screen.
Do express depth through surface darkening — never add shadows.
Do mix text-stroke (outlined) and solid fill within the same Bebas Neue headline.
Do keep body copy at or below 65ch.
Do use Framer Motion whileInView for section reveals and whileTap: { scale: 0.97 } for button interactions.
Do treat every badge and category tag as a sticker: pill-shaped, high contrast, Plus Jakarta Sans Bold.
Do use glow blobs (large blur-3xl divs, 10–20% opacity) as atmospheric background decoration on hero sections.
donts: Don't use Jarritos or refresco clásico aesthetics: naïf illustration, retro-folk palettes, hand-drawn type, tierra tones.
Don't use DTC American minimalism: cream backgrounds, single geometric sans, oversized whitespace.
Don't use pastel colors or cute rounded illustration.
Don't add cold European fashion reserve — extreme whitespace, micro-type, grey-on-white.
Don't write a box-shadow. Depth is darker surfaces.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text + gradient). Prohibited.
Don't create neutral breathing-room sections with light backgrounds.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, top, left). Animate transform and opacity only.
